name: Gandi
description: Gandi domain registrar (API v5): check availability and prices, register, renew, restore and transfer domains (including .pl), manage contacts, name servers, glue records, DNSSEC keys, transfer locks and web redirections, and host DNS on LiveDNS (records, snapshots, DNSSEC). Purchases are charged to the Gandi prepaid account; dry runs validate first.

credential_fields.name: access_token
credential_fields.label: Personal Access Token
credential_fields.description: Gandi Personal Access Token from Account settings > Authentication options in the Gandi Admin app. Choose the organization and grant the domain and LiveDNS permissions you need (plus billing for purchases). PATs expire; renew them before expiry. Sandbox tokens come from the Gandi Sandbox Admin.

credential_fields.name: sharing_id
credential_fields.label: Organization ID (sharing_id)
credential_fields.description: Optional organization ID to bill purchases to or filter by. Pass it as sharing_id on the tools that accept it.

credential_fields.name: api_endpoint
credential_fields.label: Gandi API endpoint
credential_fields.description: Use the sandbox endpoint with a sandbox token to test purchases without being charged.

tools.name: register_domain
tools.description: Register a new domain. This is a paid purchase charged to the account's prepaid balance. Check price and availability with check_availability first, confirm the price with the user, then validate with dry_run=1 before placing the real order. The owner contact is required; some TLDs (including .pl) need extra_parameters (see get_tld). Track progress with get_creation_status.
